T1.description: Reference MenuItemIndicator preceded the label, unlike the pinned upstream composition; ms-auto moved the reference label.
T1.regression: repeatability.json: four menu variants, three independent contexts per provider

T2.description: Pointer parking closed the reference appearance submenu after the old visibility assertion.
T2.regression: pages-repeatability.json and final state checked before and after each screenshot

T3.description: Old SF fixture had default TTS configured; actual reference GET default TTS returns data:null. New isolated fixture has no model defaults; an explicit both-side configured supplement tests card presence.

T4.description: WidgetRenderer lacked the Scene renderer settled callback; the old capture continued after timeout. Actual completed paint now reports readiness; timeout rejects capture.

R1.description: Identical explicit floating RGBA source-over inputs can produce a one-channel-unit CSS versus Skia output difference. This is not permission to change tokens or thresholds, and does not explain geometry/text differences.
R1.implementation: supplemental alpha-composite fixture in app/tool/ui_parity_probe.dart and tool/visual/react_ui/host.tsx
R1.regression: repeatability.json; raw alpha-composite PNGs; original strict scores retained

G1.description: Desktop operator incorrectly wrapped when local remaining width was below 480 despite desktop viewport. Source uses flex space-between and a 400px floor. Shared justified row keeps desktop single-row overflow behavior and separate mobile wrapping.
G1.regression: app/test/workflow_operator_test.dart; canvas_touch_test.dart; actual Last Run captures

G2.description: Public workflow used centered generic column rather than input/result columns; chat lacked original sidebar/conversation/composer shell. New shared responsive layout reuses public transport and existing runtime widgets.
G2.regression: public_app_page_test.dart; actual public browser execution, SSE and reload recovery

C1.description: Inline delete confirmation omitted upstream background blur, panel background and radius.
C1.regression: shared design tests and all four raw control variants

C2.description: Select incorrectly inherited glass menu surface and regular 14/20 text. Upstream Select uses opaque panel background and medium 13/16 items. Separate surface style reuses menu interaction machinery.

C3.description: Textarea lacked native resize behavior. Shared resize preserves controlled value and exposes keyboard/accessibility actions. Normal-flow fixture uses existing font-derived replaced-inline strut; no per-label pixel offset.
C3.reference: packages/dify-ui/src/textarea/index.tsx and native textarea inline layout
C3.regression: textarea resize/value/parent-width/semantics tests and all four raw variants

S1.description: Deferred original functions such as marketplace/KB/Agent entries, public batch/history management/settings are not replaced with inert controls. Exact raw images and scores still include these differences.
S1.regression: Full matrix has the same 450 declared scenarios

U1.description: Remaining node/page-specific geometry, icon, text wrapping, border, shadow and compositing differences require attribution. A high RGB score or delta<=1 statistic is not a root cause or visual acceptance.
U1.regression: Per-scene raw before/after PNGs and unchanged strict Pixel/RGB metrics

U2.description: Actual paired code panel shows Monaco continuation lines retaining leading indentation; the Flutter EditableText continuation starts at the left text boundary. Source enables Monaco wordWrap:on; the native editor delegates wrapping to RenderEditable after computing column width. This is not a font-centering or token-color issue. Do not inject spaces into stored source or apply per-line offsets. A future repair must preserve logical-text/cursor/selection/IME mapping and reuse the pinned Monaco line-break rules.
U2.regression: editors-subset2 state-facts.json and both raw panel-code pairs; full matrix retains exact images/scores

T5.description: Real model-free runs create real run and autosave timestamps. The browser Date and draft GET metadata are fixed, but subsequent writes and SSE are real. Actual Last Run paired UI still shows different Test Run/Auto-Saved timestamps. Preserve all text and strict scores; do not normalize runtime frames or call these pixels an accepted layout difference.
T5.regression: Expected successful terminal and result tab are checked independently of the raw screenshot score.
